firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently read a fantasy novel or watched a fantasy movie or show goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Players take individual turns in clockwise order, moving their character and then taking one action.
In solo play, control two or more characters of your choice.
Specific instructions on cards or in the adventure book take precedence over the general rulebook.
